from pathlib import Path
p=Path('/home/ubuntu/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/runs/adhoc-primeagentlearner-1790689839/attempts/999ba5f7203e4d1c9459d496b4c7cec5/system/state/workspace/programs/task-c14727a2.py')
p.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
code='''def transform(grid):
    n = len(grid)
    out = [[0] * (3 * n) for _ in range(3 * n)]
    for tile_r in range(3):
        for tile_c in range(3):
            tile = [row[:] for row in grid]
            if tile_r == 0:
                tile = tile[::-1]
            if tile_c == 0:
                tile = [row[::-1] for row in tile]
            if tile_r == 2:
                tile = tile[::-1]
            if tile_c == 2:
                tile = [row[::-1] for row in tile]
            for r in range(n):
                for c in range(n):
                    out[tile_r*n+r][tile_c*n+c] = tile[r][c]
    return out
'''
p.write_text(code)
exec(compile(code,str(p),'exec'),globals())
